title: Sages helped by the gods founded a new civilization at Lake Van
summary: Matt tells of Sages helped by the gods founded a new civilization at Lake Van, about post-flood antiquity at Lake Van, Turkey, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

plain: A guest named Matt, speaking on Jesse Michels's podcast about a great change around 12,000 BC, tells a story set at Lake Van in eastern Turkey after an ancient flood. He says a group of very wise sages, who were literally being helped by the gods as the old accounts describe it, created something new in that region. If true, it would mean civilization was restarted with help from beyond.
